altJa: 炭火の網の上で焼かれる魚と串焼き、立ちのぼる煙
descriptionEn: Whole fish and meat skewers grilling over glowing charcoal with smoke rising.
credit: Photo by Jan Ledermann on Unsplash
notes: Panagsama Beach, Moalboal, Cebu, Philippines (street grill, not Japan). Right edge includes a red sausage and BBQ pork skewers; for a robata feel, bias object-position toward the left/center. Warm orange/charcoal tones.
notesJa: 撮影地：フィリピン・セブ島モアルボアルの屋台の炭火焼き台（日本ではない）。右端にソーセージ等が写るため、サイトでは表示位置を左寄りにして魚を主役にしている。

altJa: 夜の町家の入口。灯りに照らされた橙色ののれんと格子戸
descriptionEn: Entrance of a traditional Kyoto machiya at night: a lamp lights an orange noren curtain beside dark wooden lattice.
credit: Photo by Chrishaun Byrom on Unsplash
notes: Kyoto, Japan (machiya townhouse, not a restaurant). Retouched: small printed name/logo on the noren and a small wall nameplate were blurred out. Portrait; very dark with orange accent. A red bucket marked 防火用 (fire use) remains at bottom right.
notesJa: 撮影地：京都の町家（飲食店ではない）。のれんに印刷された小さな名称・ロゴと壁の表札をぼかし加工で除去。右下に「防火用」のバケツが写る。

altJa: 鉄の焼き台で赤く燃える炭
descriptionEn: Close-up of chunks of lump charcoal glowing red inside a metal grill box.
notes: São Paulo, Brazil. Lump charcoal, not true white binchotan; reads as charcoal fire. Dark with red-orange glow.
notesJa: 撮影地：ブラジル・サンパウロ。白炭（備長炭）ではなく一般的な木炭。

altJa: 皿に盛られたタレ焼きの焼き鳥（ねぎま・つくね等）
descriptionEn: Close-up of glazed Japanese chicken yakitori skewers on a blue-patterned plate.
notes: Photographer description: 'Japanese style Chicken BBQ Yakitori'. Location not stated. Warm tones.
notesJa: 撮影者の説明は「Japanese style Chicken BBQ Yakitori」。撮影地の記載なし。

altJa: 木のテーブルに並ぶ塩焼きの串焼き、唐揚げ、ポテトサラダとドリンク
descriptionEn: Salt-grilled skewers (chicken, pork belly, shiitake), karaage and drinks on a wooden izakaya table.
credit: Photo by Dean Zhang on Unsplash
notes: Location not stated. An out-of-focus menu stand at top center shows some unreadable print. Low-key warm wood; also usable for course/izakaya mood.
notesJa: 撮影地の記載なし。上部のメニュー立てはピンぼけで文字は読めない。

altJa: 炭火のまわりに串打ちで立てられた塩焼きの川魚
descriptionEn: Salt-crusted river fish on bamboo skewers standing around a charcoal fire bordered with straw.
credit: Photo by Diana Bondarenko on Unsplash
notes: Kashima Jingu Shrine (Ibaraki, Japan) — outdoor festival-style stall, daylight with dark green background. Portrait.
notesJa: 撮影地：茨城県・鹿島神宮の屋外の露店。日中の撮影。

altJa: 黒い石皿に盛られたマグロ、サーモン、白身、カニカマの刺身盛り合わせ
descriptionEn: Assorted sashimi (tuna, salmon, white fish, imitation crab, tamago) on a dark slate plate.
credit: Photo by MChe Lee on Unsplash
notes: Location not stated. Includes kanikama (imitation crab). Dark background, neutral-warm.
notesJa: 撮影地の記載なし。カニカマを含む。

altJa: 染付の鉢に盛られたおでん（大根、こんにゃく、卵、たこ、手羽先）
descriptionEn: Oden in a blue-striped bowl: daikon, konnyaku, egg, octopus, fried tofu and a chicken wing with mustard.
credit: Photo by Nicholas Ng on Unsplash
notes: Location not stated. Soft daylight-ish but warm; wooden table.
notesJa: 撮影地の記載なし。おでん。

altJa: 海苔をのせたざるそばと、そば猪口・薬味
descriptionEn: Zaru soba topped with shredded nori, with a cup, grated daikon, lemon and scallion condiments.
credit: Photo by Kouji Tsuru on Unsplash
notes: Location not stated (Japan likely). A blurred paper menu is in the background (unreadable). Portrait.
notesJa: 撮影地の記載なし。背景の紙のメニューはぼけて読めない。

altJa: 木の台に置かれた白い徳利と二つのぐい呑み
descriptionEn: A white tokkuri sake flask and two ceramic sake cups on a worn wooden board, dark background.
credit: Photo by Nichika Sakurai on Unsplash
notes: Tagged Hakata, Japan. Retouched: a brewery name printed on the right cup was blurred out. Low-key, warm wood.
notesJa: 撮影地：福岡・博多（タグより）。右のぐい呑みに印刷された酒蔵名をぼかし加工で除去。

altJa: 木のテーブルに置かれた氷入りのハイボール風ロンググラスとナッツ
descriptionEn: Tall glass of an amber iced fizzy drink (highball-style) on a coaster, with a bowl of nuts in a dim bar.
credit: Photo by Rochelle Lee on Unsplash
notes: Location not stated. Photographer describes it as an iced beverage/cocktail; the drink type is not confirmed as whisky highball. A person's arm is blurred in the background (no face). Portrait.
notesJa: 撮影地の記載なし。撮影者の説明は「氷入りの飲み物」で、ウイスキーのハイボールかは未確認（alt は「ハイボール風」と記載）。背景に人の腕がぼけて写る（顔なし）。

altJa: 柔らかな照明の白木のカウンターに並ぶ小皿と木のさじ、包丁
descriptionEn: Close view of a pale wooden counter with small plates, wooden spoons and a kitchen knife under soft downlights.
notes: Location not stated (appears to be a Japanese counter restaurant). Shows the counter surface rather than seats. Different restaurant from the table photo. Portrait.
notesJa: 撮影地の記載なし（日本のカウンター店と思われる）。席ではなくカウンターの卓上が写る。テーブル席の写真とは別の店。

altJa: 障子と畳の和室に置かれた座卓と座椅子
descriptionEn: Tatami room with a low black table, floor chairs and cushions, shoji screens opening to a garden.
credit: Photo by Susann Schuster on Unsplash
notes: Arai Ryokan, Shuzenji, Izu, Shizuoka, Japan (ryokan guest room, not a restaurant). Brighter daytime image than the rest of the set; cushions have large decorative calligraphy pattern.
notesJa: 撮影地：静岡県伊豆市修善寺の旅館の客室（飲食店ではない）。他の写真より明るい日中の写真。

altJa: 木の格子で仕切られたのれん付きのテーブル席とキャンドル
descriptionEn: Wooden slatted booth seating with dark fabric curtains, rattan pendant lights and candle-lit tables.
notes: Atlanta, GA, USA (Japanese-style restaurant). Cropped: top ~17% removed to exclude sake barrels showing a real brand name and a security camera. Different restaurant from the counter photo. Portrait.
notesJa: 撮影地：米国アトランタの和風レストラン。実在銘柄の酒樽と防犯カメラが写る上部約17%をトリミングで除去。カウンターの写真とは別の店。

altJa: 夜の暗がりに灯る梅の絵柄の白い提灯
descriptionEn: A white paper lantern painted with plum blossoms glowing at night against warm bokeh lights.
credit: Photo by Nguyen Minh Kien on Unsplash
notes: Asean Resort, Thach That, Hanoi, Vietnam (Japanese-style decor). No text on the lantern. Dark with orange bokeh.
notesJa: 撮影地：ベトナム・ハノイ近郊のリゾート（和風の装飾）。提灯に文字はない。

altJa: 朱塗りの盆に並ぶ刺身、吸い物、小鉢などの和定食・会席風の料理
descriptionEn: A multi-dish Japanese seafood meal on red-rimmed lacquer trays: sashimi with sweet shrimp and shellfish, soup and small dishes.
credit: Photo by Zion C on Unsplash
notes: Amanohashidate, Miyazu, Kyoto, Japan. Daylight but dark lacquer tones; red accents.
notesJa: 撮影地：京都府宮津市・天橋立。日中の撮影。
